notes.title: Jack Is Missing is now free!
notes.content: First of all, I want to thank all of the players that have supported me by purchasing the game in its early states. Jack Is Missing was a prototype and learning project, it contained simple story plot and a limited 'One Room' based map. I understand that a lot of players are calling this a bad game, or not complete. I am still learning and I respect opinions from a lot of players that his should have been free, and that was my mistake so now I will be making Jack Is Missing free. I'm open to ideas and suggestions that can help me improve, and also to a lot of people asking, the reason I made this game originally paid was to cover some of the expenses. In this update, or maybe the last update of the game, I have removed some of the things as players pointed out that could lead to potential copyright infringement, and I really want to thank them for pointing it out as that I did not research fully on copyright issues. But anyways, now Jack Is Missing is free, even though it is not much of a great game, I still hope you will enjoy,

notes.title: Update V1.0.4 Performance Optimization and Bug Fixes
notes.content: Jack Is Missing has been updated to V1.0.4. The new update includes more optimization on performance, which allows a more smooth gameplay. The update also features changes to motion blur, because a lot of people did not like the heavy use of motion blur. Some reported bugs have also been fixed, including a bug that causes the player to skip over a big part of the game story plot.

notes.title: Performance Issue
notes.content:
Hi! A lot of you have mentioned problems with the performance. I will be releasing an update soon to patch the performance issue, and also improve the motion blur since a lot of people had said that I went too heavy on motion blur...

You are welcome to create a discussion and tell me what you think about the motion blur :)

notes.title: Release date delayed to 8/28
notes.content: The release date for Jack Is Missing is changed from 8/22/2018 to 8/28/2018 due to app testing problems. Sorry for the delay, a 25% off launch discount will be applied as a result of this delay :)
